Hi Laura / Tom — great to meet you (virtually). I’ll be your Customer Success Manager for the activation and post-sign runbook. Below is a proposed activation plan and checklist to make the June 6 kickoff as efficient as possible.

Proposed kickoff (June 6) — 30–45 min:
- Introductions: exec sponsor, product lead, security contact, CS + Solutions + Tech Lead
- Goals: agree acceptance criteria and evaluation metrics
- Immediate blockers: access, allowlist, billing/PO status
- Next steps & owners

30-day activation plan (high level):
Week 0 (kickoff, 0–3 days)
  - Access & auth: create API keys, set RBAC, exchange allowlist IPs (Samir)
  - Environment: sandbox endpoints + sample dataset
  - Evaluation plan: finalize 50-sample prompt set, define pass/fail thresholds
Week 1 (integration + eval)
  - Integration smoke tests (latency p50/p95), run initial 50-sample eval
  - Shared dashboard set up (tokens, latency, error rates)
Week 2 (scale & tuning)
  - Throughput test to 200 req/min, KV cache tuning, recommend quantization profile if needed
Week 3–4 (finalize & cutover)
  - Remediation of any P1 items, run acceptance suite, plan production cutover

Owners / contacts from Redwood:
- Marissa Cole (CS Manager) — lead for activation and success metrics
- Grace O'Connor (Solutions Architect) — evaluation templates & prompt tuning
- Aditya Rao (Account Exec) — procurement & exec escalation

Pre-kick checklist (what we need before Jun 6):
- Network allowlist (Samir)
- Billing contact & PO or confirmation of terms
- List of sample prompts + success criteria (we can accept a spreadsheet or quick doc)
- Access to sandbox/test data if there are privacy requirements

Evaluation specifics (to confirm on kickoff):
- Latency target: p95 < 250ms for short prompts
- Throughput target: baseline 200 req/min with 5–10% error tolerance
- Quality: <10% hallucination for the 50-sample set (define examples on kickoff)

Attachments: activation_playbook.pdf (detailed checklist & runbooks), small template for the 50-sample prompt set will be shared in Drive after kickoff.

Can you confirm Samir is the right contact for allowlist and whether June 6 at 10:00am PT works? If that time doesn't, propose alternatives on Jun 6 (afternoon) or Jun 7.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

—
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
